en.headline: Tai Kwun to open Anne Imhof’s first Asia solo on 25 September
en.dek: House of Swans runs to 3 January 2027 at JC Contemporary, with Hong Kong Ballet performances in the galleries and tickets from HK$50.
body: Tai Kwun Contemporary will present Anne Imhof: House of Swans from 25 September 2026 to 3 January 2027, the German artist’s first major solo exhibition in Asia, across three floors of the JC Contemporary and F Hall galleries.

Tai Kwun said the show is curated by Ying Kwok and Tiffany Leung and includes a commissioned body of new work spanning installation, painting, sculpture and live performance. The institution described the piece as set in an imagined future, following a heroine moving through a chaotic cityscape.

Opening-week performances on 25 and 26 September will bring Imhof’s long-term collaborators together with dancers from Hong Kong Ballet. Further adapted performances by the ballet company are scheduled on selected dates in October and November inside the galleries.

Exhibition hours are 11am to 7pm, Tuesday to Sunday. Tai Kwun said tickets are on sale through Art-mate at HK$50 regular and HK$40 concession for full-time students, people aged 60 or above and persons with disabilities. Children aged four or below enter free. The heritage site itself remains open daily from 8am to 11pm.

zh.headline: 大館下月25日呈獻Anne Imhof亞洲首個大型個展
zh.dek: 《House of Swans》由9月25日至明年1月3日在JC Contemporary展出，香港莎蕾舞團將於展場演出，門票50港元起。
body: 大館當代美術館將於2026年9月25日至2027年1月3日舉辦Anne Imhof：《House of Swans》，是這位德國藝術家在亞洲首個大型個展，展場覆蓋JC Contemporary及jF倉三層空間。
大館表示，展覽由郭瑩及梁尚緣策展，包括全新委託作品，結合裝置、繪畫、雕塑及現場演出。館方形容作品設定於想像中的未來，講述一名女主角在紛亂城市中前行。
9月25及26日開幕周演出，將由藝術家的長期合作音樂人、舞蹈員，聯同香港莎蕾舞團舞者演出。其後10月及11月選定日子，香港莎蕾舞團亦會在展場內作改編演出。
展覽開放時間為星期二至日上午11時至下午7時。大館指門票已於Art-mate發售，正價50港元，全日制學生、60歲或以上人士及殘疾人士優惠票40港元，4歲或以下小童免費入場。大館園區則每日上午8時至晚上11時開放。
